text:
Staging deploy update: all 212 of 212 tests are passing. One test was flaky and needed a retry, but it passed on the second attempt, so I'm not worried about it.

The only thing left is QA sign-off, which we expect by 3 pm today. Our deploy window closes at 5 pm, so if sign-off arrives on time we have enough room to ship today.

Short answer: yes, there's a real chance we deploy to staging today. I'll post here as soon as QA gives the go-ahead.
